name: graphwing-pr-drive-run-control
description: Dormant run-control variant of graphwing-pr-drive. Same topology; the writer launches under the carried CTX.INPUT.run_control reservation and settles it from the live wait body, and the continue leg fingerprints its kick, reserves, consumes, kicks with four-field continuity, and closes a failed kick as authority loss. API start only with { "input": { ..., "run_control": {...} } }; form and webhook starts are disabled. Published with --only all like every dormant graph, or by name behind its durable chain; never with --only pr-drive.
